about: Live checks of the modelpin CLI on the Claude API and the OpenAI API, 2026-11-23. null = baseline and check on the SAME model, so any regression is a false alarm; migration = baseline on `from`, check on `to`. runs=5, --match strict, confirmation on, judge gpt-4.1-mini (neither side). 4 scenarios from examples/suite, temperature 0. Latest SDKs at the time (anthropic 2.12.0, openai 3.57.0). The Claude jobs ran on the adapter fix that ships in 0.5.5; on 0.5.4 every Claude Sonnet 4.5 call returned 400 'temperature: Extra inputs are not permitted'.
